verified_facts: Current NIFTY 50 index options have 4 weekly expiration contracts excluding monthly contracts.
NIFTY 50 index option weekly expiry day is Tuesday; if Tuesday is a trading holiday, the previous trading day is expiry.
limitations: Historical expiry-regime changes must be represented from contract-level historical data/circulars rather than assuming the current weekday for the entire sample.

sources.role: primary public 1-minute historical index/options candidate source
verified_facts: Dataset card reports 1-minute OHLCV(+OI) for NIFTY, BANKNIFTY and SENSEX around 2021-2026.
Option files contain strike, option_type and expiry, with open_interest in the schema.
Dataset card warns option coverage is partial and illiquid/far strikes can be sparse or absent.
limitations: Coverage must be validated by strategy-specific expiry/strike/date completeness before numerical testing.

verified_facts: Dataset card reports NIFTY, BANKNIFTY and SENSEX 1-minute intraday coverage from 2024 onward, with BANKNIFTY from March 2024.
Schema includes expiry, strike, option_type, OHLC, volume and oi fields.
The Upstox intraday track reports OI as NaN because the source API does not return intraday OI.
limitations: Useful as an independent price/quote replication source; not sufficient where a strategy explicitly requires intraday OI.

verified_facts: NSE publishes F&O bhavcopy/UDiFF, daily settlement prices, NCL open interest, participant-wise open interest/volumes and FII derivatives statistics reports.
limitations: Some historical trade/order data is a paid NSE product; use public reports first and escalate only where essential.

verified_facts: NSE provides historical India VIX data with downloadable CSV.
limitations: Must be joined using an information-safe timestamp/date convention.

verified_facts: NSE provides daily FII/FPI and DII trading activity reports for NSE and combined NSE/BSE/MSEI views.
limitations: Data is provisional and final FII/FPI data may require NSDL/CDSL confirmation; Phase 31 must avoid look-ahead.

sources.role: historical order/trade and EOD escalation source
verified_facts: NSE documents historical F&O trade/order data availability and EOD data products.
limitations: Paid access may be required; do not use as a default input when public validated data is sufficient.

verified_facts: Current Paytm Money brokerage calculator has Options and Futures inputs.
The calculator notes it does not include platform fees, depository charges, auto square-off charges and other fees; detailed charges are in the account-opening/tariff documentation.
limitations: Exact broker rates must be captured from the current tariff at the numerical phase start; do not hard-code old blog rates as current.
